name: 克制的喜悦

lock.brow: brows slightly raised and relaxed
lock.eyes: eyes softly narrowed, lower lids lifted, faint crow's feet
lock.mouth: mouth corners pulled back and up, lips closed, no teeth shown
lock.breath: slow even breath, one quiet exhale through the nose
lock.gesture: fingertips relax open, shoulders drop
lock.posture: spine straightens a little, chest opens
lock.gaze: gaze settles on the person or object of joy, does not dart

prompt_en: restrained joy: brows relaxed and slightly raised, eyes softly narrowed with lifted lower lids and faint crow's feet, mouth corners drawn back and up with lips closed, jaw relaxed, shoulders dropped, a single quiet exhale
prompt_zh: 克制的喜悦：眉松开微扬，眼微眯下眼睑上提带细纹，嘴角后拉上扬且双唇闭合，下颌放松，肩下沉，一次轻轻的鼻息
motion_en: the expression builds from neutral: first the lower lids lift, then the mouth corners pull back, finally the shoulders drop on an exhale; hold the smile for the last third
motion_zh: 由中性渐起：先下眼睑上提，再嘴角后拉，最后随一次呼气落肩；后三分之一保持住笑意

voice_hint.breath: one soft inhale before the line

micro_timeline.desc: lower lids lift, faint crow's feet
mouth corners pull back and up
shoulders drop on exhale, smile held

name: 震惊

lock.brow: brows shot up, forehead horizontal wrinkles
lock.eyes: eyes wide open, sclera visible above the iris
lock.mouth: mouth falls open in a soft O, jaw drops
lock.breath: sharp gasp in, breath held
lock.gesture: hands freeze mid-action, fingers splay
lock.posture: torso recoils back a few degrees, then locks
lock.gaze: gaze snaps and locks onto the shock source, unblinking

prompt_en: shock: brows shot up with horizontal forehead lines, eyes wide with sclera visible above the iris, jaw dropped in a soft O, a sharp indrawn gasp, torso recoiling back then freezing, unblinking locked gaze
prompt_zh: 震惊：双眉猛抬带额部横纹，眼睁大露出虹膜上方眼白，下颌松落成 O 型，倒抽一口气，上身回缩数度后僵住，目光锁定不眨
motion_en: start mid-motion, then everything stops at once: the gasp, the dropped jaw, the recoil; the last 30% is absolute stillness with only the eyes alive
motion_zh: 起始仍在动作中，随后全部同时停住：倒吸气、落颌、回缩；最后三成绝对静止，只有眼睛是活的

name: 无声的悲伤

lock.brow: inner brow ends pulled up and together
lock.eyes: eyes downcast, glassy, lids heavy, no tears yet
lock.mouth: mouth corners drawn down, lips pressed together
lock.breath: shallow breathing, one small catch in the throat
lock.gesture: one hand rises partway then falls back
lock.posture: shoulders rounded forward, head tipped down
lock.gaze: gaze lowered, unfocused, avoiding the other person

prompt_en: silent grief: inner brow ends pulled up and together, eyes downcast and glassy with heavy lids, mouth corners drawn down with lips pressed, jaw tight, shallow breath with a small catch in the throat, shoulders rounded forward, head tipped down
prompt_zh: 无声悲伤：眉头内侧上提靠拢，眼下垂泛光眼睑沉重，嘴角下拉双唇紧抿，下颌紧绷，浅呼吸带一次喉头哽塞，双肩前扣，头微低
motion_en: the grief arrives slowly: gaze drops first, then the brow, then the swallow; the shoulders keep sinking throughout, never recovering
motion_zh: 悲伤缓缓抵达：先垂眼，再皱眉，最后吞咽；双肩全程持续下沉，不再抬起

name: 惊恐

lock.brow: brows raised and pulled together, forehead creased
lock.eyes: eyes very wide, whites visible all around, rapid blinking
lock.mouth: mouth open and pulled back wide, lips stretched thin
lock.breath: fast shallow panting, audible
lock.gesture: fingers clawed, arms drawn in to protect the torso
lock.posture: whole body shrinks back, pressed against the wall or ground
lock.gaze: gaze darts between the threat and the exit, never settling

prompt_en: terror: brows raised and pulled together, eyes very wide with whites all around and rapid blinking, mouth open with lips stretched thin, jaw trembling, fast shallow panting, fingers clawed, whole body shrinking back, gaze darting between threat and exit
prompt_zh: 惊恐：双眉上抬靠拢额部起皱，眼极大四周露白且快速眨动，嘴张开唇被拉薄，下颌轻颤，急促浅喘，手指成爪，全身后缩，目光在威胁与出口间游移
motion_en: escalating: a flinch, then the eyes go wide, then the panting starts; the body keeps retreating and never finds safety by the end
motion_zh: 逐级升级：先一颤，再瞪眼，再起喘；身体持续后退，直到结束也没找到安全处

name: 厌恶

lock.brow: brows lowered and drawn together
lock.eyes: eyes narrowed to slits, lids partially closed
lock.mouth: upper lip raised, mouth corners pulled down and back
lock.jaw: jaw shifts slightly to one side
lock.breath: short exhale through the nose, almost a sniff
lock.gesture: one hand half-raised to wave something away
lock.posture: head pulls back and tilts away from the object
lock.gaze: gaze looks down on the object, then away

prompt_en: disgust: brows lowered and drawn together, eyes narrowed to slits, upper lip raised with corners pulled down and back, head pulling back and tilting away, a short nasal exhale
prompt_zh: 厌恶：双眉下压靠拢，眼眯成缝，上唇提起嘴角下拉后扯，头后仰并偏开，一次短促的鼻腔呼气
motion_en: a single sharp reaction that settles into a held grimace: the head pulls back first, the lip curls second, and it stays
motion_zh: 一次尖锐反应后定格为持续厌恶：先后仰头，再提上唇，之后保持不动

name: 平静

lock.brow: brows level and still
lock.eyes: eyes open at rest, steady blink rate
lock.mouth: lips closed softly, no tension in the corners
lock.jaw: jaw at rest, teeth not clenched
lock.breath: slow deep breathing, shoulders barely move
lock.gesture: hands still, resting open
lock.posture: spine vertical, weight evenly distributed
lock.gaze: gaze level and steady, slow deliberate turns

prompt_en: calm: brows level and still, eyes open at rest with steady blinking, lips closed softly, jaw at rest, slow deep breathing, hands resting open, spine vertical, level steady gaze
prompt_zh: 平静：双眉平展静止，眼自然睁开眨眼节奏均匀，双唇轻合，下颌放松，缓慢深呼吸，双手自然摊放，脊背挺直，目光平稳
motion_en: almost nothing moves: one slow blink, one slow breath, and a deliberate turn of the gaze; stillness is the performance
motion_zh: 几乎不动：一次慢眨眼，一次慢呼吸，一次有意识的转视；静止本身就是表演

name: 屏息期待

lock.brow: brows raised slightly, held there
lock.eyes: eyes wide but focused, blink suppressed
lock.mouth: lips parted slightly, breath held
lock.breath: breath held, chest frozen mid-inhale
lock.gesture: fingers curled slowly, gripping nothing
lock.posture: body leans forward a few degrees, weight on the balls of the feet
lock.gaze: gaze fixed on one point, unblinking

prompt_en: held anticipation: brows raised and held, eyes wide but focused with blinking suppressed, lips parted, chest frozen mid-inhale, body leaning forward, gaze fixed on one point
prompt_zh: 屏息期待：双眉微扬并维持，眼睁大但聚焦且抑制眨眼，双唇微张，胸腔停在吸气中段，身体前倾数度，目光锁定一点
motion_en: everything winds tighter: the lean deepens, the fingers curl, the breath stays held until the very end where it finally releases
motion_zh: 一切越绷越紧：前倾加深，手指收拢，气息一直屏到最后一刻才释放

name: 信任与托付

lock.brow: brows soft and level, inner ends slightly up
lock.eyes: eyes soft, lids relaxed, looking directly at the other
lock.mouth: lips closed in a faint easy line, not a smile
lock.breath: one long slow exhale that releases the shoulders
lock.gesture: an open palm offered, or both hands still
lock.posture: body angled openly toward the other person, no guard
lock.gaze: sustained soft eye contact, no breaking away

prompt_en: trust: brows soft and level, eyes soft and relaxed looking directly at the other, lips closed in a faint easy line, one long slow exhale releasing the shoulders, body angled openly with no guard, sustained soft eye contact
prompt_zh: 信任托付：双眉柔和平展内侧微提，眼神柔和放松直视对方，双唇轻合成一条松弛的线，一次长缓呼气放下肩，身体开敞面向对方无防备，持续柔和对视
motion_en: the guard comes down: the exhale releases the shoulders first, then the gaze softens and stays; the body never turns away
motion_zh: 防备解除：先随呼气放下肩，再眼神软化并停留；身体始终没有转开

name: 压抑的暴怒

lock.brow: brows pushed low and hard together, deep vertical crease
lock.eyes: eyes locked forward, unblinking, lower lids tensed
lock.mouth: lips pressed into a hard flat line, corners white
lock.jaw: jaw clenched, masseter bulging at the hinge
lock.breath: slow heavy breaths through the nose, flared nostrils
lock.gesture: one fist closed so tight the knuckles whiten, held perfectly still
lock.posture: body absolutely still, coiled, chest barely rising
lock.gaze: gaze fixed on the target without blinking

prompt_en: suppressed rage: brows pushed low and hard together with a deep vertical crease, eyes locked forward and unblinking, lips pressed into a hard flat line with white corners, jaw clenched with the masseter bulging, slow heavy nasal breaths with flared nostrils, one fist closed so tight the knuckles whiten, body absolutely still and coiled
prompt_zh: 压抑的暴怒：双眉死死下压靠拢带深竖纹，眼锁死前方不眨，双唇抿成一条硬线嘴角发白，下颌紧咬咬肌鼓起，缓慢沉重的鼻息鼻翼张开，单拳紧握到指节发白，身体纹丝不动如蓄势
motion_en: nothing erupts: the pressure only builds — the jaw tightens further, the fist trembles once, the nostrils flare wider; the rage stays inside for the whole shot
motion_zh: 没有爆发，只有加压：下颌越咬越紧，拳头抖一次，鼻翼张得更开；整镜情绪始终压在体内

micro_timeline.desc: pressure at maximum, still not released

name: 阴鸷杀意

lock.brow: brows very slightly lowered, perfectly level, no crease
lock.eyes: eyes half-lidded, pupils constricted, completely dry
lock.mouth: mouth closed and level, the faintest upward twitch at one corner
lock.breath: breathing almost stopped, chest barely moves
lock.gesture: hand rests near the weapon, no grasp yet
lock.posture: body motionless, weight shifted forward onto one leg
lock.gaze: dead level gaze, no blink for the entire shot

prompt_en: cold kill intent: brows very slightly lowered and perfectly level, eyes half-lidded with constricted pupils and completely dry, mouth level with the faintest upward twitch at one corner, breathing almost stopped, body motionless, dead level gaze without a single blink
prompt_zh: 阴鸷杀意：双眉极轻微下压且完全水平无纹，眼半阖瞳孔收缩毫无湿润，嘴部水平单侧嘴角极微上挑，呼吸近乎停止，身体静止不动，死水平视线整镜不眨一次
motion_en: the coldest kind of stillness: only one thing moves in the whole shot, the single upward twitch at the mouth corner, everything else is dead
motion_zh: 最冷的静止：整镜只有一处动——嘴角那一下极微上挑，其余全部死寂

micro_timeline.desc: one faint upward twitch at the mouth

name: 挑衅得意

lock.brow: one brow raised, the other level
lock.eyes: eyes half-lidded, looking down at the other person
lock.mouth: one mouth corner pulled up in a crooked half-smile
lock.jaw: jaw loose and relaxed, chewing nothing
lock.breath: slow relaxed breathing, one short scoff
lock.gesture: one hand open, palm up, inviting the other to try
lock.posture: weight on one leg, hip cocked, body angled but not squared
lock.gaze: looks the other person up and down, then holds the eyes

prompt_en: provocative smugness: one brow raised and the other level, eyes half-lidded looking down at the other, one mouth corner pulled up in a crooked half-smile, one short scoff, one open palm inviting the other to try, weight on one leg with the hip cocked
prompt_zh: 挑衅得意：单眉上挑另一持平，眼半阖俯视对方，单侧嘴角吊起成歪斜半笑，一声短促嗤笑，单掌摊开示意对方尽管来，重心落单腿胯部微侧
motion_en: the look travels: eyes scan the other person from head to toe, then the half-smile appears, then the scoff; the posture never straightens
motion_zh: 视线先走：从头到脚扫过对方，再浮起半笑，再嗤一声；姿态始终没有正过来

name: 嫉妒扭曲

lock.brow: brows drawn down and in, one slightly higher
lock.eyes: eyes narrowed, watching sideways from under the brow
lock.mouth: mouth pressed flat, one corner tucked in and bitten
lock.breath: a sharp inhale held, then a hard exhale
lock.gesture: one hand grips an object until it deforms or creaks
lock.posture: shoulders hunched slightly, body half-turned away but watching
lock.gaze: sideways glare that flickers back to the object of envy

prompt_en: jealousy: brows drawn down and in with one slightly higher, eyes narrowed watching sideways from under the brow, mouth pressed flat with one corner tucked in and bitten, jaw grinding once, one hand gripping an object until it creaks, body half-turned away but still watching
prompt_zh: 嫉妒扭曲：双眉下压内收一侧略高，眼眯起自眉骨下斜看，嘴抿平一侧嘴角内咬，下颌碾动一次，单手攥物至发出声响，身体半侧却仍在看
motion_en: the glare and the grip intensify together: the jaw grinds, the hand tightens, and at the end the corner of the mouth is released from between the teeth
motion_zh: 瞪与攥同步加剧：下颌碾动，手越攥越紧，结束时嘴角从齿间松开

name: 不甘倔强

lock.brow: brows set low and level, holding the line
lock.eyes: eyes burning, wet but refusing to spill, staring straight up
lock.mouth: mouth shut hard, lower lip bitten flat
lock.jaw: jaw lifted, chin raised against the pressure
lock.breath: breath forced through the nose, fighting for control
lock.gesture: fists clenched at the sides, arms trembling with effort
lock.posture: knees bent, body pushing up against gravity, refusing to stay down
lock.gaze: stares up into the eyes of whoever is standing over them

prompt_en: defiance: brows set low and level, eyes burning and wet but refusing to spill, mouth shut hard with the lower lip bitten flat, chin raised, breath forced through the nose, fists clenched at the sides trembling with effort, body pushing up against gravity, staring straight up into the eyes of whoever stands over them
prompt_zh: 不甘倔强：双眉低平死守，眼含光带湿却不肯落下，嘴紧闭下唇被咬平，下颌抬起对抗压迫，气息自鼻腔强行呼出，双拳紧握于体侧因用力而抖，身体顶着重力往上撑，直视俯视者的眼睛
motion_en: the push upward never stops: the body rises a few degrees more, the chin lifts higher, the eyes stay wet but never break; the effort increases to the last frame
motion_zh: 向上的支撑从未停止：身体再多撑起几度，下颌抬得更高，眼含湿意但始终没垮；用力直到最后一帧仍在增加

micro_timeline.desc: down but not beaten, gaze rises
eyes wet but unbroken, still rising

name: 决绝赴死

lock.brow: brows settled, low and completely calm
lock.eyes: eyes clear and open, no fear, no moisture, one slow blink
lock.mouth: mouth closed in a level line, no tension at the corners
lock.breath: one deep inhale, then complete stillness of the chest
lock.gesture: hands stop shaking, fingers straighten deliberately
lock.posture: body squared to the threat, weight forward, ready to move
lock.gaze: gaze goes past the threat to something beyond, then returns

prompt_en: absolute resolve: brows settled low and completely calm, eyes clear and open without fear, mouth closed in a level line, one deep inhale then stillness, hands stop shaking and fingers straighten deliberately, body squared to the threat with weight forward
prompt_zh: 决绝赴死：双眉落定低垂且完全平静，眼神清澈睁开无惧无湿，嘴闭合成水平线，一次深吸气后胸膛静止，手不再抖且手指有意识伸直，身体正面迎向威胁重心前移
motion_en: the fear drains out: the trembling stops first, then the breath deepens, then the gaze steadies; the body commits forward and does not hesitate again
motion_zh: 恐惧被排空：先停止颤抖，再呼吸加深，再目光稳定；身体向前决然迈出，此后再无犹疑

name: 癫狂失控

lock.brow: brows jerking up and down, no fixed position
lock.eyes: eyes bulging, pupils huge, blinking rapidly and out of rhythm
lock.mouth: mouth open in a rictus, teeth bared, lips pulled high
lock.jaw: jaw working constantly, grinding and chattering
lock.breath: ragged uncontrolled gasping, audible and irregular
lock.gesture: hands clutch at the head, the air, or nothing at all
lock.posture: body rocking or twitching, unable to hold any position
lock.gaze: gaze jumps wildly between points, never holds

prompt_en: frenzy: brows jerking with no fixed position, eyes bulging with huge pupils and rapid irregular blinking, mouth open in a rictus with teeth bared, jaw working constantly, ragged uncontrolled gasping, hands clutching at the head and air, body rocking unable to hold position, gaze jumping wildly
prompt_zh: 癫狂失控：双眉上下抽动无固定位置，眼外凸瞳孔极大且快速无节律眨眼，嘴咧开龇牙唇被高高拉起，下颌持续咀嚼般磨动，气息粗乱失控可闻，双手抓挠头部与空气，身体摇晃无法保持姿势，目光狂乱跳跃
motion_en: no moment repeats: every part moves at a different rhythm, the gasping gets louder, and the shot ends mid-motion with no resolution
motion_zh: 没有任何重复：每个部位节奏各异，喘息越来越响，镜头在动作中途结束不给收束

name: 冷笑轻蔑

lock.brow: one brow raised high, the other flat
lock.eyes: eyes half-lidded, looking down the nose
lock.mouth: one corner of the mouth lifts into a thin cold smirk
lock.breath: one short exhale through the nose, almost a snort
lock.gesture: one hand makes a small dismissive flick
lock.posture: body leans back, creating distance from the other
lock.gaze: looks past the other person as if they are not worth the look

prompt_en: cold sneer: one brow raised high and the other flat, eyes half-lidded looking down the nose, one mouth corner lifting into a thin cold smirk, one short nasal exhale almost a snort, one small dismissive flick of the hand, body leaning back to create distance
prompt_zh: 冷笑轻蔑：单眉高挑另一持平，眼半阖自鼻梁下视，单侧嘴角提拉成薄冷假笑，一次短促鼻息近乎哼声，单手做一个小小的拂开动作，身体后靠拉开距离
motion_en: the dismissal lands in three beats: the brow goes up, the smirk forms, the hand flicks; the body never leans back in
motion_zh: 轻蔑分三拍落地：先挑眉，再成形假笑，再拂手；身体始终没有重新前倾

name: 威压逼视

lock.brow: brows lowered into a straight hard line
lock.eyes: eyes fixed and unblinking, lids slightly narrowed
lock.mouth: mouth closed, speaking with almost no lip movement
lock.breath: slow controlled breathing, deliberately audible
lock.gesture: one hand presses flat on the table or the other's shoulder
lock.posture: body leaning in, closing the distance, occupying the space
lock.gaze: gaze bores into the other person, never releasing

prompt_en: intimidation: brows lowered into a straight hard line, eyes fixed and unblinking with slightly narrowed lids, mouth closed and speaking with almost no lip movement, slow deliberately audible breathing, one hand pressing flat on the table, body leaning in and occupying the space, gaze boring in without release
prompt_zh: 威压逼视：双眉压成一条直线，眼锁定不眨眼眼睑微眯，嘴闭合几乎不动唇地说话，缓慢刻意可闻的呼吸，单手平按在桌面，身体前压侵占空间，目光如钉不松开
motion_en: the pressure advances: the lean deepens, the hand presses harder, and the gaze never releases for a single frame
motion_zh: 压迫持续推进：前倾加深，手掌更用力，目光在任何一帧都没有松开

name: 惊惶失措

lock.brow: brows raised high and drawn together tightly
lock.eyes: eyes darting rapidly, unable to focus on anything
lock.mouth: mouth open, words breaking off unfinished
lock.breath: short fast breaths, hyperventilating
lock.gesture: hands flutter uselessly, grabbing and releasing
lock.posture: body twists between two directions, unable to choose
lock.gaze: gaze snaps left, right, back — never settles

prompt_en: panic: brows raised high and drawn tightly together, eyes darting rapidly without focus, mouth open with words breaking off unfinished, jaw loose and trembling, short fast hyperventilating breaths, hands fluttering and grabbing uselessly, body twisting between two directions
prompt_zh: 惊惶失措：双眉高抬并紧紧靠拢，目光急速游移无法聚焦，嘴张着话说到一半断掉，下颌松垮颤抖，短促快速的过度换气，双手无用地抓放，身体在两个方向间扭动
motion_en: pure disorientation: the head snaps one way then the other, the hands catch on nothing, and the breath gets shallower to the end
motion_zh: 纯粹的失向：头猛转向一侧又转向另一侧，双手什么也抓不住，呼吸到最后越来越浅

name: 绝望空洞

lock.brow: brows completely slack, no expression at all
lock.eyes: eyes open but empty, pupils slightly dilated, lids drooping
lock.mouth: mouth slightly open, no muscle tone, no movement
lock.breath: very slow shallow breathing, almost nothing
lock.gesture: hands hang open at the sides, palms empty
lock.posture: body collapsed inward, as if the spine has given up
lock.gaze: gaze fixed on nothing, does not track any object

prompt_en: despair: brows completely slack with no expression, eyes open but empty with slightly dilated pupils and drooping lids, mouth slightly open with no muscle tone, jaw hanging slack, very slow shallow breathing, hands hanging open and empty, body collapsed inward as if the spine gave up, gaze fixed on nothing
prompt_zh: 绝望空洞：双眉完全松垮毫无表情，眼睁着却空洞瞳孔微散眼睑下垂，嘴微张无肌肉张力，下颌松垂，极缓极浅的呼吸，双手空垂于体侧掌心空无一物，身体向内坍塌仿佛脊背放弃支撑，目光落在虚无
motion_en: nothing changes and that is the point: the only movement is the shallow breath, slowing further by the end
motion_zh: 没有任何变化，这正是重点：唯一的动静是浅呼吸，且到结束前还在变慢

name: 崩溃痛哭

lock.brow: brows crushed together, deep creases at the inner ends
lock.eyes: eyes squeezed shut, tears streaming, lashes clotted
lock.mouth: mouth open wide in a sob, corners pulled back hard
lock.breath: broken sobbing gasps, irregular and loud
lock.gesture: both hands cover the face or clutch at the chest
lock.posture: body folds forward, shoulders shaking in waves
lock.gaze: eyes closed, no gaze at all

prompt_en: breakdown: brows crushed together with deep creases at the inner ends, eyes squeezed shut with tears streaming and clotted lashes, mouth open wide in a sob with corners pulled back hard, jaw quivering, broken loud sobbing gasps, both hands covering the face, body folded forward with shoulders shaking in waves
prompt_zh: 崩溃痛哭：双眉挤在一起内侧深沟，眼紧闭泪流成行睫毛黏结，嘴大张成哭腔嘴角用力后扯，下颌不可控地抖，断续响亮的抽泣式喘息，双手掩面，身体向前折起双肩成波抖动
motion_en: the sob arrives in waves: each gasp is louder, the shoulders shake harder, and the hands press tighter into the face
motion_zh: 哭声成波抵达：每次抽气更响，肩抖得更厉害，手更用力压进脸

name: 委屈含泪

lock.brow: inner brows lifted high, outer ends drooping
lock.eyes: eyes welling, lower lids tight and shiny, blinking fast to hold it
lock.mouth: lower lip pushed out and trembling, corners pulled down
lock.jaw: jaw pressed tight to stop the quiver
lock.breath: hitched breathing, one audible sniff
lock.gesture: fingers twist together or clutch the sleeve
lock.posture: shoulders drawn up small, head tilted down but eyes looking up
lock.gaze: looks up through the lashes, pleading without words

prompt_en: aggrieved: inner brows lifted high with outer ends drooping, eyes welling with tight shiny lower lids and fast blinking, lower lip pushed out and trembling, jaw pressed tight, hitched breathing with an audible sniff, fingers twisting together, shoulders drawn up small, looking up through the lashes
prompt_zh: 委屈含泪：眉头内侧高高提起外端下垂，眼蓄泪下眼睑紧绷发亮且快速眨眼，下唇前噘颤抖嘴角下拉，下颌用力压紧止住抖动，呼吸一顿一顿带一次出声吸鼻，手指绞在一起，双肩缩起，自睫毛下向上看
motion_en: fighting the tears and losing: the blink rate rises, the lip trembles harder, and the sniff comes at the very end
motion_zh: 一直在忍但终将失守：眨眼频率升高，唇抖得更厉害，吸鼻发生在最后一刻

name: 落寞寂寥

lock.brow: brows level but the outer ends droop slightly
lock.eyes: eyes half-lidded, looking at something far away and gone
lock.mouth: mouth closed and level, the faintest downward set
lock.jaw: jaw relaxed, no tension to hold up
lock.breath: one long slow sigh that empties the chest
lock.gesture: one hand rests on a surface, unmoving, forgotten
lock.posture: body turned away, small in the frame, shoulders dropped
lock.gaze: gaze lost in the middle distance, unfocused and still

prompt_en: loneliness: brows level with outer ends drooping slightly, eyes half-lidded looking at something far away and gone, mouth closed with the faintest downward set, one long slow sigh emptying the chest, one hand resting forgotten on a surface, body turned away and small in frame, gaze lost in the middle distance
prompt_zh: 落寞寂寥：双眉持平外端微垂，眼半阖望着某个已远去的东西，嘴闭合带一丝极轻的下压，一次长缓叹息掏空胸腔，单手搁在台面静止被遗忘，身体侧转在画面中显得很小，目光失落在中景远处
motion_en: time passing rather than acting: the sigh, then a slow drift of the gaze, then nothing more
motion_zh: 不是表演而是时间流逝：一次叹息，目光缓慢漂移，之后再无动作

name: 愧疚自责

lock.brow: inner brows pulled up in a pleat of distress
lock.eyes: eyes downcast, unable to meet the other, lids heavy
lock.mouth: mouth pressed tight, one corner drawn in
lock.breath: breath held, then a shaky release
lock.gesture: one hand reaches out and pulls itself back
lock.posture: body curled slightly inward, making itself smaller
lock.gaze: gaze keeps dropping to the floor and being forced back up

prompt_en: guilt: inner brows pulled up in a pleat of distress, eyes downcast and unable to meet the other, mouth pressed tight with one corner drawn in, jaw clenched against speaking, breath held then shakily released, one hand reaching out and pulling itself back, body curling inward, gaze dropping to the floor
prompt_zh: 愧疚自责：眉头内侧上提成痛苦的褶，眼下垂不敢与对方相触，嘴紧抿一侧内收，下颌用力咬住不说，气息先屏后颤地释放，单手伸出又自己收回来，身体微微内蜷缩小自己，目光反复落到地面
motion_en: the reaching and the withdrawing: the hand almost touches, the eyes almost meet, and both fail every time
motion_zh: 伸出去又收回来：手几乎触到，眼几乎对上，而两者每一次都失败

micro_timeline.desc: shaky release, still not looking up

name: 思念恍惚

lock.brow: brows softly raised, floating
lock.eyes: eyes softened, unfocused, seeing something not present
lock.mouth: lips barely parted, a faint almost-smile that never completes
lock.breath: one slow breath, held a beat too long
lock.gesture: fingertips touch an object belonging to the absent person
lock.posture: head tilted slightly, body still, leaning toward nothing
lock.gaze: gaze aimed at empty space as if someone is standing there

prompt_en: longing: brows softly raised and floating, eyes softened and unfocused seeing something not present, lips barely parted with a faint almost-smile that never completes, fingertips touching an object belonging to the absent person, head tilted, gaze aimed at empty space as if someone stands there
prompt_zh: 思念恍惚：双眉柔缓上扬如浮着，眼神软化失焦看着不在场的东西，双唇微启一个永未完成近乎是笑的表情，指尖触碰属于那个缺席之人的物件，头微偏，目光投向空处仿佛有人站在那里
motion_en: the almost-smile tries to form twice and fails both times; the fingertips stay on the object until the end
motion_zh: 那个近乎是笑的表情两次试图成形都失败；指尖直到最后都停在物件上

name: 疲惫虚脱

lock.brow: brows heavy, sitting low over the eyes
lock.eyes: eyes red-rimmed, lids at half-mast, blinking slowly and late
lock.mouth: mouth slightly open, lips dry and slack
lock.jaw: jaw slack, no strength to hold it
lock.breath: heavy slow breathing through the mouth
lock.gesture: one hand propping up the head, or both hands on the knees
lock.posture: body slumped, spine curved, supported by something
lock.gaze: gaze blurry, lagging behind any movement

prompt_en: exhaustion: brows heavy sitting low over the eyes, eyes red-rimmed at half-mast with slow late blinking, mouth slightly open with dry slack lips, heavy slow breathing through the mouth, one hand propping up the head, body slumped with a curved spine, gaze blurry and lagging
prompt_zh: 疲惫虚脱：双眉沉重低压在眼上，眼带红圈半阖眨眼缓慢且迟滞，嘴微张唇干而松，张口沉重缓呼吸，单手撑着头，身体瘫软脊背弯曲靠某物支撑，目光模糊跟不上动作
motion_en: gravity wins slowly: the head sinks a little more, one blink comes very late, and the body never straightens
motion_zh: 重力慢慢取胜：头又沉下一点，一次眨眼来得极迟，身体始终没有挺直

name: 麻木空洞

lock.brow: brows flat, no signal whatsoever
lock.eyes: eyes open but unfocused, blink reflex delayed
lock.mouth: mouth closed and level, totally neutral
lock.breath: breathing mechanical, no emotional rhythm
lock.gesture: hands perform an action correctly with no presence behind it
lock.posture: body upright and functional, as if on automatic
lock.gaze: gaze passes through everything it lands on

prompt_en: numbness: brows flat with no signal, eyes open but unfocused with delayed blink reflex, mouth closed and totally neutral, breathing mechanical with no emotional rhythm, hands performing an action correctly with no presence behind it, body upright and functional as if on automatic, gaze passing through everything
prompt_zh: 麻木空洞：双眉平坦毫无信号，眼睁开却失焦眨眼反射延迟，嘴闭合完全中性，呼吸机械没有情绪节律，双手正确完成动作却没有任何人味，身体挺直如自动运转，目光穿透所见一切
motion_en: the body functions while the person is absent: the action completes cleanly and the face never changes once
motion_zh: 身体在运转而人已缺席：动作干净利落地完成，脸一次都没有变过

name: 狂喜爆发

lock.brow: brows flung up, forehead fully creased
lock.eyes: eyes crinkled shut or blazing wide, tears of joy at the rim
lock.mouth: mouth wide open in a full laugh, teeth and tongue visible
lock.breath: laughing breaths, loud and uncontrolled
lock.gesture: both arms thrown up or out, fingers spread wide
lock.posture: body launched upward, weight off the ground for a moment
lock.gaze: gaze thrown upward or straight at the thing longed for

prompt_en: euphoria: brows flung up with the forehead fully creased, eyes crinkled shut or blazing wide with tears of joy at the rim, mouth wide open in a full laugh with teeth visible, jaw dropped and released, loud uncontrolled laughing breaths, both arms thrown up with fingers spread, body launched upward
prompt_zh: 狂喜爆发：双眉猛扬额部完全起皱，眼笑成缝或灼然睁大带喜极的泪光，嘴大张成完整大笑露出牙齿，下颌完全松开落下，响亮失控的笑式呼吸，双臂高举张开十指，身体向上弹起
motion_en: the release is physical: the arms go up first, the head tips back, the laugh takes over the whole body and keeps going
motion_zh: 释放是身体性的：先举臂，再仰头，笑意接管全身并持续不止

name: 心动羞涩

lock.brow: brows lifted and slightly drawn together, soft
lock.eyes: eyes widened then immediately dropped, long lashes visible
lock.mouth: lips pressed together over a smile that cannot be held back
lock.jaw: jaw relaxed, head dips to hide
lock.breath: breath catches once, chest rises and holds
lock.gesture: one hand rises to cover the mouth or touch the hair
lock.posture: body half-turns away while the face keeps wanting to look back
lock.gaze: gaze flickers to the person, away, then back again quickly

prompt_en: lovestruck shyness: brows lifted and softly drawn together, eyes widened then immediately dropped with long lashes visible, lips pressed over a smile that cannot be held back, breath catching once, one hand rising to cover the mouth, body half-turning away while the face keeps wanting to look back, gaze flicking away and back
prompt_zh: 心动羞涩：双眉上提并轻柔靠拢，眼睁大随即立刻垂下长睫可见，双唇紧压住一个藏不住的笑，气息顿一次胸膛起而停，单手抬起掩口，身体半转开而脸却一直想回头，目光闪开又迅速回来
motion_en: three flickers: look, look away, look back — and the third look lasts longer than the first two
motion_zh: 三次闪动：看、避开、再看回来——而第三次停留得比前两次都久

name: 燃起斗志

lock.brow: brows snapped down and forward, a hard focused V
lock.eyes: eyes blazing, pupils bright, zero wasted blinks
lock.mouth: mouth set in a hard line or open in a shout
lock.jaw: jaw driven forward, neck tendons showing
lock.breath: one sharp inhale that fills the whole chest
lock.gesture: fist clenched and driven down or forward
lock.posture: body coiled and launching, all forward momentum
lock.gaze: gaze locked on the goal, never wavers

prompt_en: fired up: brows snapped down and forward in a hard focused V, eyes blazing with bright pupils and zero wasted blinks, jaw driven forward with neck tendons showing, one sharp inhale filling the whole chest, fist clenched and driven forward, body coiled and launching with forward momentum, gaze locked on the goal
prompt_zh: 燃起斗志：双眉猛然下压前压成锐利 V 字，眼灼亮瞳孔有光毫无多余眨眼，下颌前顶颈筋显现，一次锐利吸气灌满胸腔，拳紧握并向前砸出，身体蓄势迸发全部向前，目光锁定目标
motion_en: one direction only: the inhale, the forward drive, and the momentum continues past the last frame
motion_zh: 只有一个方向：吸气、前冲，而势头越过最后一帧仍在继续

name: 释然和解

lock.brow: brows lift and spread, the crease between them smoothing out
lock.eyes: eyes close for one long beat, then open clearer than before
lock.mouth: mouth corners release upward, an unforced easy smile
lock.jaw: jaw unclenches, the tension visibly leaving the hinge
lock.breath: one very long exhale, the longest in the scene
lock.gesture: shoulders drop and the hands open, palms up
lock.posture: body settles, weight dropping down and back into itself
lock.gaze: gaze softens and finally lands, no longer searching

prompt_en: relief: brows lift and spread with the crease between them smoothing out, eyes close for one long beat then open clearer, mouth corners releasing upward in an unforced smile, jaw unclenching as tension leaves the hinge, one very long exhale, shoulders dropping with palms opening up, body settling into itself, gaze softening and finally landing
prompt_zh: 释然和解：双眉上扬展开眉间褶皱被抚平，眼闭上长长一拍再睁开比之前更清亮，嘴角松脱上扬成不费力的笑，下颌松开张力自关节处离体，一次极长的呼气，双肩落下掌心向上摊开，身体安顿回自己，目光软化终于落定
motion_en: the longest exhale in the scene: the eyes close, the jaw lets go, the shoulders drop, and the face opens last
motion_zh: 全场最长的一次呼气：眼闭上，下颌松开，肩落下，脸最后才打开

name: 傲然睥睨

lock.brow: brows level and slightly raised, utterly composed
lock.eyes: eyes steady, looking slightly down at those below
lock.mouth: mouth closed in a composed line, one corner very slightly up
lock.jaw: chin lifted a few degrees, held there
lock.breath: slow and controlled, chest high
lock.gesture: one hand adjusts a cuff or rests on a hilt, unhurried
lock.posture: spine perfectly straight, shoulders back and down
lock.gaze: gaze sweeps across the room without stopping on anyone

prompt_en: pride: brows level and slightly raised and utterly composed, eyes steady looking slightly down at those below, mouth closed in a composed line with one corner very slightly up, chin lifted and held, slow controlled breathing with the chest high, spine perfectly straight with shoulders back and down, gaze sweeping the room without stopping
prompt_zh: 傲然睥睨：双眉持平微扬极度自持，眼神稳定略向下看那些更低的人，嘴闭合成自持的线单侧极微上扬，下颌抬起数度并保持，缓慢受控的呼吸胸腔高挺，脊背笔直肩后展下沉，目光扫过全场不为任何人停留
motion_en: the gaze sweeps once and the chin stays lifted; nothing in the face yields at any point
motion_zh: 目光扫过一次，下颌始终抬起；脸在任何时刻都没有半分退让

name: 悲壮赴义

lock.brow: brows drawn together in sorrow but held steady, not collapsing
lock.eyes: eyes bright with unshed tears, open and facing forward
lock.mouth: mouth set in a firm line, no trembling allowed
lock.jaw: jaw set, chin level, head held high
lock.breath: one steady breath, no hitch, no sob
lock.gesture: one hand grips the weapon or the banner until it whitens
lock.posture: body squared and standing tall, weight forward
lock.gaze: gaze looks forward and slightly up, past the present moment

prompt_en: tragic resolve: brows drawn together in sorrow but held steady and not collapsing, eyes bright with unshed tears and facing forward, mouth set in a firm line that does not tremble, chin level and head held high, one steady breath with no hitch, one hand gripping the weapon until it whitens, body squared and standing tall, gaze forward and slightly up
prompt_zh: 悲壮赴义：双眉因悲而拢却稳稳维持没有崩塌，眼含未落之泪明亮地望向前方，嘴抿成坚线不允许颤抖，下颌持平头颅高昂，一次平稳呼吸不打顿不抽泣，单手紧握兵器至发白，身体正面挺立重心向前，目光平视略抬越过此刻
motion_en: sorrow held inside strength: the grip whitens, the eyes stay bright, and not one element breaks down
motion_zh: 悲被力量含住：握持发白，眼始终明亮，没有一处崩解

name: 狂傲大笑

lock.brow: brows raised high and held, slightly unhinged
lock.eyes: eyes wide and bright, almost too much light in them
lock.mouth: mouth open in loud laughter, head tipped back
lock.jaw: jaw loose and open, head thrown back
lock.breath: loud open laughter, breath spent freely
lock.gesture: one arm flung wide, the other braced on a knee or a surface
lock.posture: body thrown back, off balance and not caring
lock.gaze: gaze up and away, not looking at anyone

prompt_en: manic laughter: brows raised high and slightly unhinged, eyes wide and bright with almost too much light, mouth open in loud laughter with the head tipped back, loud open laughter spending breath freely, one arm flung wide, body thrown back and off balance without caring, gaze up and away from everyone
prompt_zh: 狂傲大笑：双眉高高扬起略显失控，眼睁大发亮似有过多光芒，嘴张开大笑头向后仰，响亮的开放式笑声肆意挥霍气息，单臂大张，身体后仰失衡且毫不在意，目光上抬避开所有人
motion_en: the laughter peaks and stays peaked: the head stays back, the arm stays wide, and the sound never drops
motion_zh: 笑声抵达顶点后停在顶点：头始终后仰，手臂始终大张，声音从未低落

name: 暖意温柔

lock.brow: brows soft and slightly raised at the outer ends
lock.eyes: eyes softened at the outer corners, lids relaxed and low
lock.mouth: a small closed smile, corners up and soft, no teeth
lock.breath: slow, quiet, contented breathing
lock.gesture: one hand rests gently on a shoulder, a head, or an object
lock.posture: body angled in close, leaning slightly toward the other
lock.gaze: gaze rests on the other person with total attention

prompt_en: tenderness: brows soft with outer ends slightly raised, eyes softened at the outer corners with relaxed low lids, a small closed smile with soft upturned corners and no teeth, slow quiet contented breathing, one hand resting gently on a shoulder or head, body angled in close and leaning toward the other, gaze resting with total attention
prompt_zh: 暖意温柔：双眉柔和外端微扬，眼外角变软眼睑松弛低垂，一个小小的闭合微笑嘴角柔软上扬不露齿，缓慢安静满足的呼吸，单手轻轻搭在肩头或发顶，身体贴近并微微倾向对方，目光全然投注
motion_en: the lean in: the hand settles, the gaze rests, and the small smile simply stays for the rest of the shot
motion_zh: 一个靠近：手落定，目光安放，那个小小的笑就一直保持到镜头结束

name: 眼神闪躲

lock.brow: brows unchanged, holding the surface expression
lock.eyes: eyes cut sideways for one frame, then snap back
lock.mouth: mouth holds whatever expression it already had
lock.breath: breath pauses for one beat, then resumes
lock.gesture: no gesture, or one finger stops moving
lock.posture: body unchanged, only the eyes betray
lock.gaze: gaze breaks contact for a single beat and returns

prompt_en: micro-expression, gaze aversion: the surface expression holds completely still, but the eyes cut sideways for one beat and snap back, the breath pauses and resumes, only the eyes betray anything
prompt_zh: 微表情·眼神闪躲：表面表情完全维持不动，但眼睛侧向一瞥随即弹回，呼吸顿一拍再续上，只有眼睛泄露了什么
motion_en: one beat of betrayal inside an otherwise still face: the sideways cut, the held breath, the snap back to the same expression
motion_zh: 在一张静止的脸里出现一拍的泄露：侧瞥、屏息、弹回同一个表情

micro_timeline.desc: snap back to the same face

note: 用于「表面平静、内心动摇」，必须配长一点的镜头才看得见，ECU/CU 优先

name: 嘴角抽动

lock.brow: brows unchanged
lock.eyes: eyes unchanged, maybe one extra blink
lock.mouth: one mouth corner twitches up or down once, then is controlled
lock.jaw: jaw tightens for a moment to suppress it
lock.breath: breath unchanged
lock.gesture: a finger or thumb presses against something
lock.posture: posture unchanged, the twitch is the whole event
lock.gaze: gaze steady, the twitch is the only tell

prompt_en: micro-expression, mouth twitch: the face holds completely still except for one mouth corner that twitches once and is immediately controlled, the jaw tightening for a moment to suppress it, gaze steady throughout
prompt_zh: 微表情·嘴角抽动：整张脸完全静止，只有一侧嘴角抽动一下立刻被控制住，下颌为压制它而瞬间绷紧，全程目光平稳
motion_en: one twitch, one suppression, and back to stillness — the whole event lasts under a second
motion_zh: 一次抽动、一次压制、回到静止——整个事件不足一秒

name: 瞳孔骤缩

lock.brow: brows very slightly drawn in
lock.eyes: pupils constrict sharply, then the lids narrow a fraction
lock.mouth: mouth closes from slightly parted to shut
lock.breath: breath stops for one full beat
lock.gesture: the hands stop whatever they were doing
lock.posture: the body goes still from the shoulders down
lock.gaze: gaze sharpens onto a single point and stays

prompt_en: micro-expression, pupil constriction: pupils constrict sharply, the lids narrow a fraction, the mouth closes from parted to shut, the breath stops for one full beat, the hands stop moving, the body goes still from the shoulders down, the gaze sharpens onto a single point
prompt_zh: 微表情·瞳孔骤缩：瞳孔急剧收缩，眼睑再收窄一分，嘴由微张转为闭合，呼吸整整停一拍，双手停下一切动作，身体自肩以下静止，目光锐利锁定一点
motion_en: the whole body registers one thing: pupils, breath, hands, and stillness all happen within a single beat
motion_zh: 全身在同一件事上做出反应：瞳孔、呼吸、双手、静止全部发生在同一拍内

name: 喉结滚动

lock.brow: brows hold steady, maybe a small lift
lock.eyes: eyes hold contact, one delayed blink
lock.mouth: lips press together, mouth goes dry
lock.jaw: the throat works once, a visible hard swallow
lock.breath: a swallow interrupts the breathing rhythm once
lock.gesture: one hand touches the throat or the collar
lock.posture: shoulders rise a fraction and stay raised
lock.gaze: gaze holds but is no longer quite as steady

prompt_en: micro-expression, hard swallow: the throat works once in a visible hard swallow, lips pressing together as the mouth goes dry, one delayed blink, a hand touching the throat or collar, shoulders rising a fraction and staying raised, the gaze holding but no longer quite steady
prompt_zh: 微表情·喉结滚动：喉结用力滚动一次清晰可见，双唇因口干而压紧，一次迟到的眨眼，单手触及喉咙或衣领，双肩抬起一分并停在那里，目光仍在维持但已不那么稳
motion_en: the swallow is the whole shot: it interrupts the breath, the shoulders rise with it, and the face holds everything else back
motion_zh: 吞咽就是整镜：它打断呼吸，双肩随之抬起，而脸把其他一切都压住了

name: 手指收紧

lock.brow: brows unchanged or slightly lowered
lock.eyes: eyes unchanged, focused downward or ahead
lock.mouth: mouth unchanged, lips may press
lock.jaw: jaw tightens in sympathy with the hand
lock.breath: breath shallows
lock.gesture: fingers tighten on an object in one visible squeeze
lock.posture: the forearm tenses, tendons rise
lock.gaze: gaze stays where it is, the hand does the acting

prompt_en: micro-expression, grip tightening: the face barely changes, but the fingers tighten on an object in one visible squeeze, the forearm tensing with raised tendons, the jaw tightening in sympathy, the breath shallowing, the gaze staying fixed while the hand does the acting
prompt_zh: 微表情·手指收紧：脸几乎没有变化，但手指在一次可见的收紧中攥紧物件，前臂绷起筋腱，下颌同步绷紧，呼吸变浅，目光停在原处而由手来演
motion_en: the emotion moves from the hand upward: the squeeze, the forearm tendons, the jaw, and only at the end the face
motion_zh: 情绪自手向上蔓延：攥紧、前臂起筋、下颌绷紧，直到最后才到脸上

micro_timeline.desc: hand at rest on the object

name: 呼吸一滞

lock.brow: brows barely lift
lock.eyes: eyes open a fraction wider, blink suppressed
lock.mouth: lips part on the halted inhale
lock.breath: the inhale stops halfway and hangs there
lock.gesture: all gesture freezes mid-motion
lock.posture: the whole body holds at half-tension
lock.gaze: gaze stops moving mid-scan

prompt_en: micro-expression, halted breath: the inhale stops halfway and hangs there, lips parted on the halted breath, eyes opening a fraction wider with the blink suppressed, all gesture freezing mid-motion, the whole body holding at half-tension, the gaze stopping mid-scan
prompt_zh: 微表情·呼吸一滞：吸气停在半途悬在那里，双唇因中断的气息而微张，眼再睁大一分且抑制眨眼，一切手势在动作中途冻结，全身维持在半张力状态，目光在扫视中途停住
motion_en: everything stops at half: the breath, the hands, the gaze — and the shot ends before anything resumes
motion_zh: 一切停在半途：呼吸、双手、目光——而镜头在任何东西恢复之前就结束了
note: 最适合「意识到某事」的瞬间，通常接一镜反应或反转
